timeline.tweet: So when all happened at almost the same time.. I was diagnosed with severe depression and Burnout. In Sweden it’s called Exhaustion syndrome. I was sleeping 18hrs a day and still never felt rested.

At the same time I had issues with a chronic bowel disease called Collagenous Colitis. Got very sick and started chemotherapy. I’m still on it. Chemo through pills every day. And every side effect that comes with it.
Fell in to a deep deep depression in about 3 years ago. I’ve had a hard time with expressing myself since. Still feels like I have nothing positive to say.
